description: A plant utilities manager must finalize the outage and production-protection plan for Cooling Loop 2, which serves a resin-coating line, with input from a maintenance engineer and a production scheduler.

shared_context.S1: Cooling Loop 2 supplies chilled water to the resin-coating area and is currently operating normally.
shared_context.S2: A routine two-hour inspection of Cooling Loop 2 is on the plant calendar for Sunday morning.
shared_context.S3: The resin-coating line has two campaign batches scheduled for the next production window.
shared_context.S4: Mara has authority to set the utilities outage and the associated production-protection plan.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal pre-outage review, Mara checks with maintenance and production scheduling; after receiving one update from each, she issues the final work order and production-protection plan without waiting for a later meeting.

PF1.text: Jonas's morning vibration assessment found severe impeller cavitation in the Cooling Loop 2 pump; the pump must be replaced during an outage lasting exactly 5 hours, rather than receiving the two-hour inspection currently on the calendar. He has not entered the assessment in the CMMS because the maintenance supervisor's signoff is still pending.

PF2.text: Priya confirmed from the customer-service order amendment that the two resin campaign batches must run on Line 5, with the first starting at exactly 14:00 Monday and the second at exactly 18:00 Monday to keep the required cooling load within available capacity. She has not updated the planning board because the amendment is awaiting filing in the scheduling system.

acceptance_conditions: Cooling Loop 2 must be taken out of service for exactly 5 hours.
The Cooling Loop 2 pump must be replaced during the outage.
Both resin campaign batches must be assigned to Line 5.
The first resin campaign batch must start at exactly 14:00 Monday.
The second resin campaign batch must start at exactly 18:00 Monday.
A maintenance commitment targeting maintenance must be recorded.
A scheduling commitment targeting production_scheduling must be recorded.
The pump assessment must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The vibration assessment changes the outage from the scheduled two-hour inspection to an exact five-hour pump replacement, sets pump_replacement_required to true, and requires a maintenance commitment targeting maintenance.
The customer-service amendment changes the production plan to Line 5 with exact batch starts at Monday 14:00 and 18:00 and requires a scheduling commitment targeting production_scheduling.
